verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a documented migration guide covering imports from Postgres, Firebase, Auth0, Heroku, RDS, Neon, etc. (supabase-docs-24, supabase-docs-38), giving a concrete path to bring an existing production database in. However, the docs pack contains no specifics on minimizing downtime (e.g., logical replication/cutover strategy) and community feedback explicitly calls out migration/local-dev workflow as 'Supabase's biggest weakness' with live prod migrations being painful (supabase-comm-5, supabase-comm-6), indicating the path is not smooth or low-downtime in practice. Missing for 10: explicit downtime-minimization guidance (replication/cutover steps), first-party case studies of low-downtime imports, and resolution of the community-reported migration pain points.
